theory: Face, edge and vertex formulae and the corresponding procedure step are outside the supplied section's taught method and question types. Explain that valid nets must have matching edge lengths and an arrangement that folds without overlap or gaps; the current count-based teaching and several solutions omit these necessary checks. Qualify the general polygon-and-rectangles statements as applying to right prisms.

summary: Corrected the triangular and trapezoidal net dimensions, removed unsupported counting and invalid-net tasks, and supplied cited naming and complete-net sketching replacements while retaining the required tier and quiz minimums. Revised theory text and procedure steps to apply to right prisms and require matching edges and folding without overlap or gaps; these theory edits are not whole-item removals.
reviewSummary: All twelve final items and the theory are accepted: the nets, construction instructions and quiz answers are correct and use booklet question types. All fourteen removals are justified by the actual source tasks, tier minimums remain satisfied, and no worked examples were supplied.
